_comment: Per-type campaign configuration for scripts/campaign.py (bb/pt/ctf workflow driver). Data, not code: change behaviour by editing here. `approach` must appear in playbook.json's fingerprint `approach` lists. `osint:false` for ctf skips pass 0 unless the skill is invoked with an osint arg. `phase_default_tools`, `visual_evidence_classes`, `reframe_lenses` and `refuter_prompt` are shared across all three types.
_reframe_comment: Generative lenses first (off-playbook, chain-first) so the driver deterministically produces rows before the narrative lenses that need agent recon; otherwise two front-loaded dry lenses would terminate the campaign before the productive ones run.
refuter_prompt: You are an adversarial verifier. Try to REFUTE this candidate finding, do not confirm it. Default to refuted=true when uncertain. Check: (1) is the observed behaviour a differential, or was only one branch ever seen; (2) is it an edge/WAF artifact rather than the application; (3) is it already public / a vendor default; (4) does the impact actually reach the target's own data or systems (RoE upstream-vendor rule). Return {refuted: bool, reason: str}.
